meta.title: Four in a Row
meta.description: Drop your discs and connect four before your rival. Against a friend or the CPU.

modes.label: Game mode
modes.pvpHint: Take turns on the same phone. Whoever lost starts the next one.
modes.cpuHint: You play pink. The CPU thinks several moves ahead.

streak.rules: The streak grows with each consecutive win against the CPU (draws don't break it). Losing or quitting a game in progress resets it to 0.
